summary: First full test of StaffHub. Backend: 15 pytest cases covering auth/me, dashboard, users, role changes (admin-only, can't demote self), seeded channels, channel messages, unread counts and /read, DMs (idempotent, DM notification, privacy for a 3rd user), channel creation, certificate upload validation, valid/expiring/expired status, sort order, scope=all admin-only, file download owner/admin-only, soft delete, expiring notification and email (backend logs show HTTP 202), updates/policies/events/tasks admin-only with notification fan-out, policy acknowledge, RSVP toggle, task PATCH by assignee, notifications read-one/read-all. All 15 pass. test_tasks failed once in 4 runs under xdist and passed on retry. Frontend (390x844 web preview): login screen, token bypass, Home dashboard, all 4 tabs, sending in #general, new DM, certificates list with scope toggle, upload form validation, real file upload through the file chooser, delete via confirm sheet, opening a cert file, Library rows (admin and employee), all 5 compose flows as admin, policy acknowledge, event RSVP (admin and employee), task toggle, notifications (tap navigates, read-all), team role toggle, sign out. All of these work. No red screens or page errors. Only minor UX/design issues found. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: The response returns a stale notified_stage='valid' even when check_certificate has just set it to 'expiring'/'expired' in the DB. notified_stage is an internal field and is exposed in all cert responses.
Returns {ok:true} for a nonexistent id. Should return 404.
Runs one count_documents query per conversation (N+1) to get unread counts. Will be slow with many DMs.
The admin's own new policy counts as 'pending' for that admin, who has to acknowledge their own policy.
The long-lived session token is put in the URL query string, where it can leak into browser history and proxy logs. Consider a short-lived signed download token.

ui_bugs.issue: A validation error (e.g. 'Expiry date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format.') stays visible after the user fixes the field, e.g. by tapping a +1 year chip. It only clears on resubmit.
An employee who deep-links to /compose?type=update sees the full form. The backend correctly rejects the submit with 'Admins only', but the screen has no client-side role guard.

issues: headerRight add button (events-new-button etc.) is 28x32 and flush against the right screen edge (right=390, no margin). Below 44pt and visually clipped. Add marginRight/padding and hitSlop or a 44x44 container.
Scope chips (cert-scope-mine/all) and team-role-toggle are 36px tall (below 44pt).
Make admin / Make employee toggles the role instantly with no confirmation sheet (a sheet exists elsewhere for deletes).
When opened by deep link or page refresh (e.g. /events, /tasks) there is no back arrow, so on web the user can only leave via the browser back button.

react_native_issues.issue: keyboardVerticalOffset={0} under a native stack header may leave the input partly covered on iOS. Verify on a device; may need the header height as offset. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:55
Polls the full message list (up to 200 messages) every 3s and ignores the backend's 'after' param. Wasteful on mobile data and battery. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx:25

action_items: Optional: add a margin and a 44x44 hit area to the headerRight add buttons (events/tasks/policies/updates), and bump chat-send-button to 44x44
Optional: clear the upload/compose error state when the user edits a field or taps a quick chip
Optional: guard compose.tsx client-side (redirect or empty state for non-admins)
Optional: add a confirmation before changing a team member's role
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/updates/{id} for unknown ids, and return the updated notified_stage (or drop the field) in cert responses
Optional: auto-acknowledge a policy for its author, or exclude the author from pending_policies
Optional: use the 'after' param for incremental chat polling
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 684 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting routers (chat, certificates, content) before adding features.
Session token in the download URL query string (src/api.ts:57). Prefer a short-lived signed URL.
Email sending is wrapped and never raises, so certificate upload cannot fail on email errors. Good.
seed_data_creation: Test suite upserts a 3rd user user_TEST_third01 with session token test_session_third_TEST (kept for DM privacy tests). All TEST_/UI_TEST content created during testing has been cleaned up. IMPORTANT: the UI sign-out test deleted the seeded test_session_employee session (logout deletes the session). I re-seeded it in user_sessions with a 30-day expiry.
flaky_tests: TestContent::test_tasks: failed once in 4 runs under xdist (-n 2), passed in isolation and on rerun. Root cause not determined.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app/backend (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use -n 0 for serial runs). Web bypass: wait for login-screen, run localStorage.setItem('auth_token', JSON.stringify('test_session_admin')), then reload or goto. Setting it before the page loads results in the login screen. The Sign out flow deletes the seeded session in the DB; re-seed test_session_employee/admin afterwards. Each uploaded expiring/expired cert sends one real email. The DocumentPicker on web works with page.expect_file_chooser.
